title: Every saved clip becomes an .alc in a folder beside its sample
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Saved clips as .alc files

  Background:
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "steady-120.wav" in Bb major with sections A and B
    And its saved clips:
      | name   | start | end  | source | retired |
      | sec-A1 | 0.50  | 4.50 | ml     | no      |
      | loop-1 | 0.50  | 2.50 | ml     | no      |
      | shot-3 | 5.00  | 5.50 | ml     | no      |
      | riff   | 1.00  | 3.00 | user   | no      |
      | loop-9 | 2.50  | 4.50 | ml     | yes     |

  Scenario: Every saved clip becomes an .alc in a folder beside the sample
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars steady-120.wav"
    Then the folder "steady-120.wav clips" holds exactly:
      | file                      |
      | A-2bars-Bb sec-A1.alc     |
      | A-1bar-Bb loop-1.alc      |
      | B-1beat-Bb shot-3.alc     |
      | A-1bar-Bb riff.alc        |
    And the output says "4 clips written"

  Scenario: A clip file plays its region, warped
    When I export the sidecars and read "A-1bar-Bb loop-1.alc"
    Then its region is 0.50 s to 2.50 s with the loop on
    And its warp markers are the sample's markers inside that region
    And it refers to the audio "steady-120.wav"

  Scenario: Retired clips are not exported
    When I export the sidecars
    Then no file in "steady-120.wav clips" names "loop-9"

  Scenario: A sample with no saved clips gets no folder
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "tempo-change.wav" with no saved clips
    When I export its sidecars
    Then there is no folder "tempo-change.wav clips"
    And the output says "tempo-change.wav: no saved clips"

  Scenario: --no-clips writes only the sample's sidecar
    When I run "apricity export --sidecars steady-120.wav --no-clips"
    Then there is no folder "steady-120.wav clips"
```

Manual check (DAW): open the folder in the DAW's browser; names sort by section; dragging `A-1bar-Bb loop-1.alc` into a track plays one bar in time, looped.
